summary: Push a chunk into a Readable queue and preserve the backpressure boolean.

target.notes: Add the chunk to the internal queue or deliver it in flowing mode; return false when the producer should stop pushing until the runtime asks for more.

semantics.undefined_non_object_mode: treated as empty string/buffer by Node semantics

caveats: The return value is not a success/failure flag; it is flow-control guidance.
Chunk validation differs between objectMode and byte/string modes.

tests.name: push feeds data
tests.input: const {Readable}=require('node:stream'); const r=new Readable({read(){}}); r.push('x'); console.log(r.read().toString());

tests.name: push may signal backpressure
tests.expected_behavior: prints false when buffered length reaches the threshold
